segments.title: Cold Open & Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Executive Producer Pepito troubleshoot persistent streaming glitches, frame-rate drops, and audio desync while bantering about late-night television and hard-shell tacos.

segments.title: Trump–Epstein Birthday Card Report
segments.notes: Blackwell covers the Wall Street Journal report on a purported Trump-signed birthday card for Jeffrey Epstein featuring a hand-drawn nude woman and cryptic message; Rick (Amongst the Web host) interjects with a ranked list of alleged sex offenders and commentary on Apple TV+ streaming quality.

segments.title: Hard-Shell vs. Soft-Shell Taco Debate
segments.notes: Senior debate analysts Ralph Munchcut and Crum clash over taco shell preference via Crum's assistive speech device; Munch claims Mexican heritage, Crum advocates white-food-only diet, and the segment ends with a rushed Patreon plug.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Blackwell aborts the broadcast early to raid Ricky Pica, while Pepito and Crum trade final barbs about mothers and malfunctioning voice boxes.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a truncated, glitch-plagued broadcast while juggling tech failures and a looming Patreon obligation.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Identified as 'Papita' by ASR; manages the control room during severe streaming instability and deflects blame for frame-rate issues.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates taco topology through a synthetic voice device after reported vocal-cord damage, insists he only eats white foods.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends soft-shell tacos as traditional Mexican fare, claims Mexican heritage, and scores a disputed victory before the hard cut.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: Amongst the Web host. Briefly joins the news desk to deliver a ranked list of alleged sex offenders and praise Apple TV+ original programming.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Mentioned as physically present in the studio ('Jeff, why are you over there?') but does not speak on air.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Referenced by Case as running at '10 frames per second' from within the studio walls.

lore_notes.fact: Now relies on a handheld speech-synthesis device (Speak & Spell style) to communicate on air due to damaged vocal cords.
ASR consistently transcribes his name as 'Papita' during this broadcast.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News airs a severely abbreviated, technically compromised edition in which Case Blackwell and a glitch-ridden control room cover the Wall Street Journal's Trump–Epstein birthday-card exposé before pivoting to a chaotic Munch & Crum debate on taco-shell supremacy. The broadcast terminates early so Blackwell can fulfill a Patreon commitment, ending with an unscheduled raid on Ricky Pica.
